source: wordcell-pointwise evidence/jev-calibration-samples.json (frozen jev-request-shape-v1 captures joined to focal-directive labels)

plattDiagnostics.note: logistic fit diverges on this near-separable cohort (all 25 positives <= 0.52); isotonic is the correct calibrator here

findings: Raw Jev pointwise scores are poorly calibrated (ECE 0.155, logLoss 0.534).
Isotonic recalibration on 5-fold held-out data cuts ECE to ~0.019 and Brier to ~0.046 — scores become usable probabilities.
Platt/logistic diverges on this near-separable cohort; monotone isotonic is the right default for Jev scores.
Calibration must be fit on development-labeled data only and re-measured per cohort.
designConsequences: Calibration unlocks conformal coverage selection and expected-value channel packing.
Raw-score thresholds remain prohibited; calibrated probabilities may threshold.
